summary: Labeled drop-down list of options, starting with a placeholder.
use: One choice from a long list, such as a country. For a few choices, form/choice-group shows them all.

name.description: The field's name in the submitted form data.

placeholder.description: The empty first option, so no choice is made for the person.

hint.description: Help shown with the field until it's valid.

error.description: Shown when the browser finds the value invalid.

obligations: The label names the choice being made.
